title: Sort Array Using Counting Sort
statement:
Given an array of N non-negative integers where all values are in the range [0, K], sort it in non-decreasing order using **counting sort**.

Counting sort steps:
1. Build a frequency array `count[0..K]`.
2. Reconstruct the sorted output from the frequency array.

Do NOT use comparison-based sort.
inputFormat:
Line 1: two integers N and K.
Line 2: N space-separated integers (each in [0, K]).
outputFormat: N space-separated integers in non-decreasing order on a single line.
